summary: 41-year-old pilot William Zitting of Utah, solo in a Cirrus SR-22 en route from Centennial Airport to Utah, lost altitude in icing conditions over the Cement Creek valley and deployed the CAPS whole-plane parachute, landing atop Reno Divide; found cold but uninjured by CBSAR and ridden out on a snowmobile.
location: Reno Divide (top), near Cement Creek, flank of Italian Mountain
responding_agency: Crested Butte SAR; Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; CareFlight
notes: CBSAR paged ~3:30 p.m. Friday after ELT signal reached Air Force; CareFlight attempted an aerial search but weather blocked a close approach, located the site as the ground team arrived ~9 p.m. Fresh snow made for technical snowmobiling; avalanche risk noted. Plane remained on site. Incident date = Friday 2014-02-14 per the Feb 19, 2014 article.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Gunnison County, Colorado, United States)
